```{r model_tuning, eval=FALSE}
# Processed time: ~ 9-11 h !!!!

# Recipe preprocessing
pp <- recipe(vegh ~ twi + rin + elv + mat + map + srad,
             data = combined_data) |>
  step_center(all_numeric(), -all_outcomes()) |>
  step_scale(all_numeric(), -all_outcomes())

# Tuning grid
tune_grid <- expand.grid(
  mtry = c(2),
  min.node.size = c(5, 10, 15, 30, 50, 100),
  splitrule = "variance"
)

# Sample fractions to test
sample_fracs <- c(0.3, 0.5, 0.6, 0.8)

# Store all results
all_results <- list()

n_cores <- 80
cat("Using", n_cores, "cores for parallel training\n")

# Setup parallel processing
cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)

# Loop through sample fractions
for (sf in sample_fracs) {
  cat("\n========== Testing sample.fraction =", sf, "==========\n")
  
  # Create directory for models if it doesn't exist
  model_dir <- here::here("data/models")
  if (!dir.exists(model_dir)) {
    dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  set.seed(1982)
  
  ctrl <- trainControl(
    method = "cv",
    number = 3,
    savePredictions = "final",
    allowParallel = FALSE,
    verboseIter = FALSE
  )
  
  
  model <- train(
    pp,
    data = combined_data,
    method = "ranger",
    trControl = ctrl,
    tuneGrid = tune_grid,
    metric = "RMSE",
    replace = FALSE,
    sample.fraction = sf,
    num.trees = 200,
    num.threads = n_cores,  
    importance = "impurity",
    seed = 1982
  )
  
  # Save model
  saveRDS(model, file.path(rf_models_dir, paste0("rf_model_sf_", sf, ".rds")))
  
  # Save results
  all_results[[as.character(sf)]] <- model$results |>
    mutate(sample.fraction = sf)
  
  # Output best model
  best <- model$bestTune
  cat("Best for sf=", sf, ": mtry=", best$mtry, 
      ", min.node.size=", best$min.node.size, 
      ", RMSE=", min(model$results$RMSE), "\n")
  
  rm(model)
      gc()
}

# 8. 重要：关闭并行集群，释放资源
stopCluster(cl)
registerDoSEQ()  # 恢复串行模式
```


```{r combine_result}
# Reload saved models and extract results
all_results <- list()

# Get all saved model files
model_files <- list.files(rf_models_dir, pattern = "rf_model_sf_.*\\.rds", full.names = TRUE)

for (model_file in model_files) {
  # Extract sample fraction from filename
  sf_value <- gsub(".*rf_model_sf_|\\.rds", "", model_file)
  sf_value <- as.numeric(sf_value)
  
  # Load the model
  model <- readRDS(model_file)
  
  # Display best model info (like in original)
  best <- model$bestTune
  cat("Best for sf=", sf_value, ": mtry=", best$mtry, 
      ", min.node.size=", best$min.node.size, 
      ", RMSE=", min(model$results$RMSE), "\n")
  
  # Store results
  all_results[[as.character(sf_value)]] <- model$results |>
    mutate(sample.fraction = sf_value)
  
  # Clean up
  rm(model)
  gc()
}

# Combine all results
results_df <- bind_rows(all_results) |>
  select(mtry, min.node.size, sample.fraction, RMSE, Rsquared, MAE, 
         RMSESD, RsquaredSD, MAESD) |>
  arrange(RMSE)

write_csv(results_df, here::here("data/tuning_results_full.csv"))

# Display combined results
print(results_df)

# Find overall best model
best_overall <- results_df |> 
  slice_min(RMSE, n = 1)

cat("\n========== Overall Best Model ==========\n")
cat("Sample fraction:", best_overall$sample.fraction, "\n")
cat("mtry:", best_overall$mtry, "\n")
cat("min.node.size:", best_overall$min.node.size, "\n")
cat("RMSE:", best_overall$RMSE, "\n")
cat("Rsquared:", best_overall$Rsquared, "\n")
cat("MAE:", best_overall$MAE, "\n")
```


```{r best-model}
# 1. 找到最佳模型并加载
best_overall <- results_df |> 
  slice_min(RMSE, n = 1)

# 加载最佳模型文件
best_model_file <- file.path(rf_models_dir, paste0("rf_model_sf_", best_overall$sample.fraction, ".rds")) 

best_model <- readRDS(best_model_file)

# 2. 获取预测值
# 方法1：从保存的CV预测中获取
predictions_cv <- best_model$pred |>
  filter(mtry == best_overall$mtry & 
         min.node.size == best_overall$min.node.size) |>
  select(obs, pred, rowIndex, Resample)

# 方法2：或者对整个数据集重新预测（如果CV预测不可用）
if(nrow(predictions_cv) == 0) {
  cat("\n使用全数据集重新预测...\n")
  # 重要：请将 "your_target_variable" 替换为实际的目标变量名
  target_name <- "your_target_variable"  # <--- 需要修改这里
  predictions_cv <- data.frame(
    obs = combined_data[[target_name]],  # 使用[[ ]]来安全提取列
    pred = predict(best_model, newdata = combined_data)
  )
}

# 3. 计算统计指标
cor_value <- cor(predictions_cv$obs, predictions_cv$pred)
rmse_value <- sqrt(mean((predictions_cv$obs - predictions_cv$pred)^2))
mae_value <- mean(abs(predictions_cv$obs - predictions_cv$pred))
r2_value <- 1 - sum((predictions_cv$obs - predictions_cv$pred)^2) / 
                sum((predictions_cv$obs - mean(predictions_cv$obs))^2)

hex_plot <- ggplot(predictions_cv, aes(x = obs, y = pred)) +
  # Hex bins
  stat_bin_hex(bins = 50, alpha = 0.8) +
  # 颜色渐变
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", 
                       trans = "log10",  # 对数转换使分布更清晰
                       name = "Count") +
  # 1:1 参考线
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, 
              color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  # 平滑拟合线（注意：在最新版本中使用linewidth代替size）
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, 
              color = "blue", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8) +
  # 添加统计信息
  annotate("text", x = min(predictions_cv$obs), 
           y = max(max(predictions_cv$obs), max(predictions_cv$pred)), 
           label = paste(
             "RMSE:", round(rmse_value, 3),
             "\nR²:", round(r2_value, 3),
             "\nMAE:", round(mae_value, 3),
             "\nCor:", round(cor_value, 3)
           ),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, 
           color = "black", bg = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  # 坐标轴标签
  labs(x = "Observed Values", 
       y = "Predicted Values",
       title = paste("Random Forest: Predicted vs Observed"),
       subtitle = paste("Best Model (mtry =", best_overall$mtry, 
                       ", min.node.size =", best_overall$min.node.size, 
                       ", sample.fraction =", best_overall$sample.fraction, ")")) +
  # 主题美化（修复版本）
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray50"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "gray90"),  # 移除 alpha
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "gray80")   # 移除 alpha
  ) +
  # 确保坐标轴比例一致
  coord_equal()

# 显示图形
print(hex_plot)

# 5. 保存图形
ggsave(here::here("data/figures/7_02_best_model_pred_vs_obs_hex.png"), 
       plot = hex_plot, 
       width = 10, 
       height = 8, 
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")

```

```{r visual}
# Figure 1: RMSE heatmap
p1 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = factor(mtry), y = factor(min.node.size), fill = RMSE)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~sample.fraction, ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "steelblue", high = "orange") +
  labs(title = "RMSE by Parameter Combination",
       x = "mtry", y = "min.node.size") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(RMSE, 2)), size = 3)

p1
ggsave(here::here("data/figures/7_02_rmse_heatmap.png"), p1, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Figure 2: RMSE vs min.node.size
p2 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = min.node.size, y = RMSE, 
                              color = factor(mtry), shape = factor(mtry))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~sample.fraction, ncol = 4) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "RMSE vs min.node.size",
       x = "min.node.size (log scale)", y = "RMSE",
       color = "mtry", shape = "mtry") +
  theme_minimal()
p2
ggsave(here::here("data/figures/7_02_rmse_vs_minnodesize.png"), p2, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Figure 3: R² comparison plot
p3 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = factor(sample.fraction), y = Rsquared, 
                              color = factor(min.node.size), group = factor(min.node.size))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = expression(paste("R"^2, " Comparison by Sample Fraction")),
       x = "sample.fraction", y = expression(R^2),
       color = "min.node.size") +
  theme_minimal()
p3
ggsave(here::here("data/figures/7_02_rsquared_comparison.png"), p3, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Figure 4: Cross-validation stability
p4 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = sample.fraction, y = RMSESD, 
                              color = factor(min.node.size), group = factor(min.node.size))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Cross-Validation Stability (RMSESD)",
       x = "sample.fraction", y = "RMSE Standard Deviation",
       color = "min.node.size") +
  theme_minimal()
p4
ggsave(here::here("data/figures/7_02_cv_stability.png"), p4, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Figure 5: Performance comparison across sample fractions
p5 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = factor(sample.fraction), y = RMSE, 
                              color = factor(min.node.size), group = factor(min.node.size))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "RMSE Comparison by Sample Fraction and Node Size",
       x = "sample.fraction", y = "RMSE",
       color = "min.node.size") +
  theme_minimal()
p5
ggsave(here::here("data/figures/7_02_rmse_comparison.png"), p5, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
